desc: Establish the finite-field monomial summation filter: a walk survives iff each zero-edge multiplicity is divisible by \(p-1\), with global factor \((-1)^K\).
Derive and validate the exact closed-form answer for \(p=2\), \(p=3\), and \(p>3\).
Check edge cases: no zero entries, all zero entries, diagonal/off-diagonal zeros, and large \(p\).
Implement the validated formula using modular matrix multiplication/exponentiation and stdin/stdout handling.
